content.short: Stablewatch delivers real-time analytics and risk advisory for stablecoins and yield-bearing stablecoins.
content.description: Stablewatch tracks stablecoins and yield-bearing stablecoins in real time, pairing analytics with risk advisory. Plasma's official documentation lists it among the analytics tools for the chain. Yield-bearing stablecoins vary widely in how their returns are generated, which makes independent tracking of backing and risk useful.
